text: Melanie, think of your life insurance like an umbrella: you have $110,000 but need more, leaving a shortfall of $490,000. Timothy has $140,000 and his shortfall is $610,000. Your household relies on both incomes, $150,000 from Timothy and $120,000 from Melanie, and losing either would be hard for Liam (6) and Josh (3) to absorb.
